about: P01 (ffw-h3g) host-side cases for the build-identity half: the typed target/profile contract (crates/franken-board-profile/src/build_contract.rs), its shared vectors, the drift check against the real manifests, the central command plan and the receipt pipeline. Expected values are written by hand. Nothing here builds, boots or contacts a device.

cases.title: the runner's own machinery (selection, expansion, exit codes, exclusive receipts) holds
workspace build and test from a different directory under --locked --offline on the central rch path, judged from committed evidence
cases.reason: the plan is built and checked here (P01-PLAN-*), but builds run only through RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 rch exec on the supervisor's central path; run the plan there, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest --revision REV --export-root DIR --target-dir DIR --step ID=LOG ...` writes the sanitized, revision-bound record under toolchain/results/p01 that this case judges
cases.owner: BeigeMaple: central run of the current plan, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest`

cases.title: the device speaker artifacts from a central build are static, the right machine, ISA revision and float ABI per the declared linkers, with digests, judged from committed evidence
cases.reason: no committed central-run record covers the two device speaker builds, or it is stale; run the current plan centrally, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest` (its artifact rows are read from the built bytes: PT_INTERP/PT_DYNAMIC, machine, .MIPS.abiflags)
cases.owner: BeigeMaple: central run of the current plan, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest`

cases.title: the Rust replay of the shared vectors by the typed contract passed centrally, by test name, against the current vectors, judged from committed evidence
cases.reason: no committed central-run record shows the current replay tests (crates/franken-board-profile/tests/p01_contract.rs) passing against the current vectors; run the workspace test centrally, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest` (it records those tests by name from the log, bound to the test file and the vectors)
cases.owner: BeigeMaple: central workspace test, then `scripts/e2e/p01 ingest`

cases.title: a pinned stable toolchain so rch --clean-overlay resolves the client toolchain
cases.reason: the root nightly pin was declined (it would move the stable crates onto nightly, and the date it named is not what the workers run); a stable pin needs the release the central workspace builds actually use, which no committed receipt records; the plan's `toolchain-default` step (plain `rustc -vV`, what a bare `cargo` resolves to on the worker and what the workspace test uses) records it, and has not run centrally yet
cases.owner: BeigeMaple: read the stable release from a central receipt, then land the file between batches

cases.title: the pinned per-target dependency, unsafe and license feature inventory
cases.reason: E06 (ffw-unk) is the declared input to P01 and is still being built; closure of P01 waits on it

cases.title: Cargo feature flags for the four native services (and artwork)
cases.reason: the harness is gated by the `harness` feature now; protected_render, the four native services and artwork still have cargo_feature empty: they are compiled in unconditionally, so a profile that 'disables' one is a contract claim the build cannot honour; the minimal-renderer artifacts are the same bytes as the full ones until each service is gated
cases.owner: S01/A01/T01/X01 owners; P01 contract flags it per artifact in every receipt

cases.title: the real workspace's `cargo metadata` resolve graphs (default, and --features franken-speaker/harness) are judged against the tree, the lockfile and nine planted faults
cases.reason: no metadata documents were supplied: cargo runs only on the central rch path, so produce `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --offline` once with default features and once with `--features franken-speaker/harness`, then run `scripts/e2e/p01 --tier full --metadata-default D --metadata-harness H`; supplied, the case is judged pass or fail and is never skipped
cases.owner: BeigeMaple: central `cargo metadata --locked --offline` for both feature sets

invariants.statement: One shared source yields distinct per-ISA artifacts; no artifact is universal across PowerPC, MIPS or ARM
An artifact's target, triple, ISA label and observed ELF machine/class/byte order agree
The crate graph is a layered acyclic graph with no unknown or self dependency
Every crate, interface and fixture has exactly one owner
Required features cannot be removed by omission or disabled in a full-product profile; optional ones may be disabled with a reason
A disabled required feature can never become qualified, even with evidence attached; qualification is computed, never asserted
Qualification evidence is bound to the exact artifact digest, target and profile, and to an accepted evidence kind
Native services are independent of each other and the minimal renderer does not depend on them
Unsafe policy is declared per crate, and no test-only, host-only or scoped-unsafe crate is in a device artifact unless a counted exception names it
Exact artifact and profile identity propagates into the receipt and is re-verified against the contract
The declared contract matches the repository: members, pending and excluded crates, dependency edges, lockfile, lints, profile values, binaries
Build and test entry points run from a different directory, offline against the lockfile, and only through the remote path
Cancellation, restart, failed steps and missing artifacts leave honest receipts and never launder a pass
Build profile values (opt-level, LTO, panic = abort on device artifacts) match the manifests
Every error code of the typed contract is exercised, and breaking any rule of the reference is noticed
The contract is data with a version and a digest that is the same across languages and layouts
A reproducible lockfile and a pinned toolchain
invariants.note: the lockfile is checked here; the pin is proposed, not landed

invariants.statement: Live central execution: offline builds from another directory, real device-artifact digests, the Rust replay
invariants.note: BLK-001/002/003 are judged from committed central-run evidence and pass only while it is current for the plan, contract, replay tests and vectors (otherwise BLOCKED, named); BLK-007 passes only when the cargo metadata documents are supplied

invariants.statement: Required native features are enforceable in the build, not only claimed in the contract
Inputs from E06 (dependency, unsafe and license inventory per target)
Runner hygiene and honesty
Every artifact maps to a known crate and profile, and an excluded crate yields artifacts only for the targets it declares

A dependency that exists only under a feature is modelled as such: live in an artifact's closure only when its profile enables the gating feature, gated by a real Cargo flag owned by the same crate, and the default build carries no test-only crate (from the manifests, and from cargo metadata once produced centrally)

A device std artifact is linked static through a declared wrapper whose digest the contract records, the plan carries the linker and crt-static tokens, and the linked file shows the declared ISA revision and float ABI where it can
invariants.note: the rules and the plan are checked here; no device speaker has linked yet, so a real static ELF with these ABI flags is P01-BLK-002

invariants.statement: A crate with a scoped unsafe allowance (a platform crate) may be in a device image only through edges a counted exception names: every active edge into it must be listed, a listed edge excuses no other, an exception for a missing edge or a safe crate is stale, and an artifact's own crate is never excused (the same all-edges rule now holds for test-only crates)
Provider, device and physical qualification are out of scope of this offline contract
invariants.note: P01 is a workspace and build-identity contract; provider and physical claims need separately authorized receipts, so no case here can apply
